shortDescription: Manages instances and virtual machines on Apache CloudStack based clouds.

options.name: account
options.description: Account the instance is related to.

options.name: affinity_groups
options.description: Affinity groups names to be applied to the new instance.

options.name: allow_root_disk_shrink
options.description: Enables a volume shrinkage when the new size is smaller than the old one.

options.name: api_http_method
options.description: HTTP method used to query the API endpoint. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_key
options.description: API key of the CloudStack API. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_KEY) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_secret
options.description: Secret key of the CloudStack API. If not set, the C(CLOUDSTACK_SECRET) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout in seconds. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_TIMEOUT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_url
options.description: URL of the CloudStack API e.g. https://cloud.example.com/client/api. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_ENDPOINT) env variable is considered.

options.name: api_verify_ssl_cert
options.description: Verify CA authority cert file. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_VERIFY) env variable is considered.

options.name: cluster
options.description: Cluster on which an instance should be deployed or started on. Only considered when I(state=started) or instance is running. Requires root admin privileges.

options.name: cpu
options.description: The number of CPUs to allocate to the instance, used with custom service offerings

options.name: cpu_speed
options.description: The clock speed/shares allocated to the instance, used with custom service offerings

options.name: details
options.description: Map to specify custom parameters.

options.name: disk_offering
options.description: Name of the disk offering to be used.

options.name: disk_size
options.description: Disk size in GByte required if deploying instance from ISO.

options.name: display_name
options.description: Custom display name of the instances. Display name will be set to I(name) if not specified. Either I(name) or I(display_name) is required.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain the instance is related to.

options.name: force
options.description: Force stop/start the instance if required to apply changes, otherwise a running instance will not be changed.

options.name: group
options.description: Group in where the new instance should be in.

options.name: host
options.description: Host on which an instance should be deployed or started on. Only considered when I(state=started) or instance is running. Requires root admin privileges.

options.name: hypervisor
options.description: Name the hypervisor to be used for creating the new instance. Relevant when using I(state=present), but only considered if not set on ISO/template. If not set or found on ISO/template, first found hypervisor will be used. Possible values are C(KVM), C(VMware), C(BareMetal), C(XenServer), C(LXC), C(HyperV), C(UCS), C(OVM), C(Simulator).

options.name: ip6_address
options.description: IPv6 address for default instance's network.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: IPv4 address for default instance's network during creation.

options.name: ip_to_networks
options.description: List of mappings in the form I({'network': NetworkName, 'ip': 1.2.3.4}) Mutually exclusive with I(networks) option.

options.name: iso
options.description: Name or id of the ISO to be used for creating the new instance. Required when using I(state=present). Mutually exclusive with I(template) option.

options.name: keyboard
options.description: Keyboard device type for the instance.

options.name: match_display_name
options.description: When searching for an instance name, also match the display name.

options.name: memory
options.description: The memory allocated to the instance, used with custom service offerings

options.name: name
options.description: Host name of the instance. C(name) can only contain ASCII letters. Name will be generated (UUID) by CloudStack if not specified and can not be changed afterwards. Either C(name) or C(display_name) is required.

options.name: networks
options.description: List of networks to use for the new instance.

options.name: pod
options.description: Pod on which an instance should be deployed or started on. Only considered when I(state=started) or instance is running. Requires root admin privileges.

options.name: poll_async
options.description: Poll async jobs until job has finished.

options.name: project
options.description: Name of the project the instance to be deployed in.

options.name: root_disk_size
options.description: Root disk size in GByte required if deploying instance with KVM hypervisor and want resize the root disk size at startup (needs CloudStack >= 4.4, cloud-initramfs-growroot installed and enabled in the template).

options.name: security_groups
options.description: List of security groups the instance to be applied to.

options.name: service_offering
options.description: Name or id of the service offering of the new instance. If not set, first found service offering is used.

options.name: ssh_keys
options.description: List of names of SSH keys to be deployed on the new instance.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the instance.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags. Tags are a list of dictionaries having keys C(key) and C(value). If you want to delete all tags, set a empty list e.g. I(tags: []).

options.name: template
options.description: Name, display text or id of the template to be used for creating the new instance. Required when using I(state=present). Mutually exclusive with I(iso) option.

options.name: template_filter
options.description: Name of the filter used to search for the template or iso. Used for params I(iso) or I(template) on I(state=present).

options.name: user_data
options.description: Optional data (ASCII) that can be sent to the instance upon a successful deployment. The data will be automatically base64 encoded. Consider switching to HTTP_POST by using I(CLOUDSTACK_METHOD=post) to increase the HTTP_GET size limit of 2KB to 32 KB. Mutually exclusive with I(user_data_name) option.

options.name: user_data_details
options.description: Map used to specify the parameters values for the variables in userdata.

options.name: user_data_name
options.description: Name of user data to be used. Mutually exclusive with I(user_data) option.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If V(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. If not given, the C(CLOUDSTACK_DANGEROUS_NO_TLS_VERIFY) env variable is considered. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: zone
options.description: Name of the zone in which the instance should be deployed.
